title: Настя разоблачает Шефа  (Nastya Confronts the Chef)

segments.t: Outraged on Elena Pavlovna's behalf, Nastya confronts Chef Barinov outside the hotel room. When she hears a man's voice inside, Barinov claims they are secretly playing poker, but Nastya doesn't buy it and reaches for her phone.
А, так вы играете в покер.
Только не говори об этом Елене.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'How can you cheat on Elena?' Notice how Russian expresses 'how' and 'Elena' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Kostya answers right away.
'Sorry, Chef, I gave you away.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'excuse me' before landing on 'turned in'.
'I am in there with Elena Pavlovna.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'Pavlovna' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Kostya, let us go, we will not disturb them.' Notice how Russian expresses 'Kostya' and 'to disturb' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Is there another man in there with you?' Nastya anchors the line on 'there', while 'man' completes the thought.
'Chef, are you going to win it back today?' The grammar packs 'Chef Barinov' and 'will' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
А, так вы играете в покер.
'Ah, so you are playing poker.' Kostya chooses the respectful plural 'you' alongside 'poker' to keep a polite distance. Chef Barinov answers right away.
Только не говори об этом Елене.
'Just do not tell Elena about this.' Chef Barinov brings out the contrast between 'only' and 'not' in a few short words.
'I promised that I would quit soon.' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'I will quit' without extra filler words.
'Then what woman ordered champagne?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'and' before landing on 'to order'.
'We are leaving here, Kostik.' The grammar packs 'are leaving' and 'from here' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'I am calling Elena Pavlovna right now.' The meaning hinges on 'I' working together with 'Pavlovna' in spoken Russian. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
А, так вы играете в покер.
Только не говори об этом Елене.
To stop Nastya from calling Elena or the police, the chefs end up tying Kostya and Nastya up in the hotel room too. See you next time!
